body: Orchestrator adversarial review of PR #293 head b66f4297 (7 commits on main e0027811; 24 files, +431/-1331). Re-derived from the diff: herdr-agents loses worker_github_config_dir, worker_github_shell_env, codex_worker_github_config, spawn_worker_with_github and notice_missing_worker_github_credential with every call site, so worker panes inherit the machine's gh login and spawn.sh is called directly; require-crit-review.py loses github_identity_errors and the ruleset/approval probes while the PR-feedback, audit and crit evidence paths are untouched; the manifest and renderer lose the three store keys and *_GH_CONFIG_DIR lines; scripts/gh-auth.sh replaces gh-auth-stores.sh with one login in gh's default directory (status → skip, tty-only device-code login with default storage, token env cleared, mise shims on PATH, no setup-git) and Makefile/setup.sh follow; the doctor reports one working login or a WARN with the make gh-auth hint and check-tools.sh drops the two-login comparison; the Codex execpolicy forbids `gh api -X|--method PUT` and `gh api graphql` with the prefix-rule limits (flag after path, -XPUT, --method=PUT) stated in the rule comment; SKILL step 10 and the agmsg-orchestration rule name `gh pr merge --squash` as the only merge procedure and drop the T90 provisioning sentence; the README's GitHub section explains one account per machine, what the integrity ruleset still enforces (PR-only, seven strict checks, thread resolution, force-push/deletion blocks, zero approvals, no bypass actors) and that Claude worker seats still lack a native merge denial. The remaining `required_approving_review_count: 0` is the intended ruleset payload. Tests: T90/T102/T103 tests removed or inverted, new single-login/doctor/execpolicy tests, 911 unit tests OK in the pasted output after one CI fix (a test had reached the runner's real gh); CI green (16 checks); threads 0; mergeStateStatus CLEAN; Codex security review completed with no findings.

Orchestrator adversarial review of PR #293 round-1 head f0a5407a (one commit on b66f4297; 4 files, +7/-4). Re-derived from the diff: SKILL step 10.5, the agmsg-orchestration rule's `main` bullet and the README now state the merge as `gh pr merge <pr> --squash --match-head-commit <audited head sha>`, which makes GitHub refuse the merge when the head moved after the audit, restoring the binding the REST `sha=` carried; the docs test pins the `--match-head-commit <audited head sha>` token in both the SKILL and the rule; the sandbox record now separates normal credential use through gh (PR creation, checks, API polling, git push with the machine's real login) from the fake-HOME tests and states that no credential value was read or printed. 911 unit tests OK in the pasted output; CI green; no review threads; mergeStateStatus CLEAN; no Bot review on f0a5407a.
